post.description: Create export job for search criteria defined via "filter" parameter. Request returns the "exportId" which is passed as a parameter in subsequent calls to Bulk Export Leads endpoints. Use Enqueue Export Lead Job endpoint to queue the export job for processing. Use Get Export Lead Job Status endpoint to retrieve status of export job. Required Permissions: Read-Only Lead

parameters.name: exportLeadRequest
parameters.description:
exportLeadRequest

ColumnHeaderNames: A JSON object containing key-value pairs of field and column header names.

Example:
"columnHeaderNames":{
"firstName":"First Name",
"lastName":"Last Name",
"email":"Email Address"
}

name.description: REST API name for header field

startAt.description: Start of date range filter (ISO-8601 format)

code.description: Error code of the error. See full list of error codes here

message.description: Message describing the cause of the error

createdAt.description: Date range to filter new leads on

smartListId.description: Id of smart list to retrieve leads from

smartListName.description: Name of smart list to retrieve leads from

staticListId.description: Id of static list to retrieve leads from

staticListName.description: Name of static list to retrieve leads from

updatedAt.description: Date range to filter updated leads on

columnHeaderNames.description: File header field names override (corresponds with REST API name)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the file

filter.description: Lead record selection criteria. Can be one of the following: "createdAt", "updatedAt", "staticListName", "staticListId", "smartListName", "smartListId"

format.description: File format to create("CSV", "TSV", "SSV"). Default is "CSV"

createdAt.description: Date when the export request was created

errorMsg.description: Error message in case of "Failed" status

exportId.description: Unique id of the export job

fileSize.description: Size of exported file in bytes. This will have a value only when status is "Completed", otherwise null

fileChecksum.description: SHA-256 hash of exported file. This will have a value only when status is "Completed", otherwise null

finishedAt.description: Finish time of export job. This will have value only when status is "Completed" or "Failed", otherwise null

format.description: Format of file as given in the request ("CSV", "TSV", "SSV")

numberOfRecords.description: Number of records in the export file. This will have value only when status is "Completed", otherwise null

queuedAt.description: Queue time of export job. This will have value when "Queued" status is reached, before that null

startedAt.description: Start time of export job. This will have value when "Processing" status is reached, before that null

ExportResponse.description: Response containing export job status information

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred if the request was unsuccessful

result.description: Array of results for individual records in the operation, may be empty

warnings.description: Array of warnings given for the operation
